headline: 1,310 newly infected as 3 more die from measles symptoms in 24 hours
summary: According to the DGHS, 1,310 people were newly infected with suspected or confirmed measles cases in the last 24 hours across Bangladesh.
details: Three more people died from measles symptoms across the country between Sunday morning and Monday morning, according to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) released Monday afternoon.
In the same 24-hour period, 1,310 new cases of suspected or confirmed measles were reported.
Since March 15 of this year, a total of 998 people have died from suspected measles and 101 from confirmed measles cases.
Since March 15, a total of 167,469 people with measles symptoms have been admitted to hospitals across the country.
Of those admitted, 160,705 people have recovered and returned home.
On Sunday, September 27, nine children died from measles symptoms and 1,341 new patients were identified.
caption:
1,310 new infections and 3 more deaths in just 24 hours. Measles is spreading rapidly across Bangladesh.

Three more people died from measles symptoms across the country between Sunday morning and Monday morning, according to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) released Monday afternoon.

In the same 24-hour period, 1,310 new cases of suspected or confirmed measles were reported.

Since March 15 of this year, a total of 998 people have died from suspected measles and 101 from confirmed measles cases.

Since March 15, a total of 167,469 people with measles symptoms have been admitted to hospitals across the country.

Of those admitted, 160,705 people have recovered and returned home.

On Sunday, September 27, nine children died from measles symptoms and 1,341 new patients were identified.
